<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Jawa pack.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. Use 3 Force each from your and your opponent's Force decks; otherwise it cannot deploy. All your Jawas are forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' Jawas travel in packs for self-defense. They ambush droids that pass through the Jundland Wastes unwarily. “Aieeya!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to both players' Force decks; the English specifies both players' Force Piles.
